events.title: Celebrate the release of The Wall Within with author Laura Morris
events.location: Canteen Kitchen + Bar, Coolum Beach, QLD 4573
events.description: Australia lost the war. Now Tess must face spirits from the past, a mysterious new boy in town and The Wall. The Wall Within, by Laura Morris is a story of survival, friendship, and hidden power - where one girl’s discovery could unravel everything. Laura will be in conversation with local legends, Roz Mackay and Pat Cavanagh. Attendees can look forward to a bookish afternoon of chats, readings, bedazzling and “shimmering” as we journey into the world of Tess and Raze. Buy some delicious food and enjoy some drinks at Canteen Kitchen + Bar, and join Laura as she shares her journey to becoming a YA debut author. Age attendance: 13+ About Laura: Laura Morris is an author and Coolum local. Her writing has appeared in QLD Writers’ Centre’s Pen and Pixel magazine, and her short story Tarnished is published in the 2025 Sydney Hammond Memorial Short Story Competition anthology. Her debut novel, The Wall Within (published by Hawkeye Publishing), made the shortlist of QWC’s Publishable program in 2022, and the longlist of the Hawkeye Manuscript Development Prize for 2025. Laura has a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Qld and a Graduate Certificate in Creative Writing from the University of the Sunshine Coast. She grew up in Ipswich and Brisbane, and now lives on the Sunshine Coast with her family. She loves writing, gardening, Game Fit Tennis, and Pickleball. Follow LauraMorrisWriter on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.
